import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open Fintype Subgroup Set Polynomial Ideal
open scoped BigOperators

theorem quotient_list_product_reordering {A : Type*} [CommGroup A] (B : Subgroup A) :
  ∀ l l' : List A,
    l.Perm l' →
      (l.map (fun a : A => (a : A ⧸ B))).prod =
        (l'.map (fun a : A => (a : A ⧸ B))).prod := by
  intro l l' h
  exact (h.map (fun a : A => (a : A ⧸ B))).prod_eq

      (l.map (fun a : A => (a : A ⧸ B))).prod =

  intro l l' h
  induction h with
  | nil =>

  | cons a h ih =>

      simp only [List.map_cons, List.prod_cons]
      ac_rfl
